title: Machete
extract:
The Machete is a  Grineer melee weapon favored by Scorpions.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Sundering Weave,  Cyclone Kraken and  Rending Wind (Conclave only) stance.

Acquisition
First acquisition is through Daily Tribute. Then the Machete's blueprint can be bought from Cephalon Simaris offerings for  100,000.

Notes
The weapon was removed from the Market in Update 10.4 (2013-10-16).
PC and PS4 players who logged in between July 9, 2014 and July 16, 2014 received a Machete blueprint as a free gift.
The blueprint was given from completing One Thousand Cuts - Mission 3.
The blueprint and weapon were available for purchase between May 25th and June 1st, 2017 —  25,000 and  90 respectively.
As of Update 20.6 (2017-05-24), Machete is available as a random login reward, in the form of a blueprint.

Trivia
Though the Machete was removed from the market in Update 10.3 (2013-10-09), its blueprint was temporarily awarded to players who logged into Warframe between July 9 and July 16, 2014 as a special gift for the delay in completing Update 14.0 (2014-07-18). It was also released as a reward for the Tactical Alert "One Thousand Cuts".
The Machete's glowing blade is believed to stem from a super-heated surface. This is true of some other Grineer melee weapons, including the  Dual Cleavers.
